- H100/H200/B200: 2026-06-10 10:00 -> 2026-06-10 16:00
- MI300: 2026-06-17 09:00 -> 2026-06-17 15:00
- Gaudi: rolling 2026-06-22 -> 2026-06-28 (APAC gating)

nora_s: SI checklist (short): image filename + sha256, driver/CUDA-ROCm matrix, example run config, perf CSV, rollback tag, eng contacts.
legal_amy: I'll draft consolidated embargo doc + demo NDA template by EOD 2150013450.

ivy_w: Also request each vendor provide a "do-not-share" bullet list for embargo period.
tom_b: Thanks 1thumbsup: we'll reconvene if Gaudi firm dates change. Keep replies inline to keep a single thread of truth.
